sentences.text_en: Machine Learning, teach a computer how to perform a task without explicitly programming it to perform said task.
sentences.text_tr: Makine ogrenmesi: bir bilgisayara, o gorevi acikca programlamadan bir gorevi nasil yapacagini ogretmek.

chunks.text_tr: sozu edilen gorev, bahsi gecen gorev

grammar.note_tr: Bir seyin nasil yapilacagini anlatir: 'how to perform' = nasil yapilacagi.

sentences.text_en: Instead, feed data into an algorithm to gradually improve outcomes with experience, similar to how organic life learns.
sentences.text_tr: Bunun yerine, deneyimle sonuclari giderek iyilestirmek icin bir algoritmaya veri besle; tipki organik yasamin ogrendigi gibi.

sentences.text_en: The term was coined in 1959 by Arthur Samuel at IBM, who was developing artificial intelligence that could play checkers.
sentences.text_tr: Terim, 1959'da IBM'de dama oynayabilen bir yapay zeka gelistiren Arthur Samuel tarafindan ortaya atildi.

grammar.note_tr: Edilgen cati: 'was coined' = ortaya atildi (kim yaptigi onemli degil).
Bir kisiyi tanimlar: 'who was developing' = gelistiren (kisi).

grammar.pattern: who was developing artificial intelligence that could play checkers

sentences.text_en: Half a century later, and predictive models are embedded in many of the products we use every day, which perform two fundamental jobs.
sentences.text_tr: Yarim yuzyil sonra, tahmine dayali modeller her gun kullandigimiz bircok urune gomulu durumda; bu modeller iki temel isi yapar.

sentences.text_en: One is to classify data, like is there another car on the road, or does this patient have cancer?
sentences.text_tr: Biri veriyi siniflandirmak: mesela yolda baska bir araba var mi, ya da bu hastada kanser var mi?

sentences.text_en: The other is to make predictions about future outcomes, like will the stock go up, or which YouTube video do you want to watch next?
sentences.text_tr: Digeri gelecekteki sonuclar hakkinda tahmin yapmak: mesela hisse yukselecek mi, ya da sirada hangi YouTube videosunu izlemek istersin?

grammar.note_tr: Gelecek ya da tahmin: 'will the stock go up' = hisse yukselecek mi.

sentences.text_en: The first step in the process is to acquire and clean up data, lots and lots of data.
sentences.text_tr: Surecteki ilk adim veriyi toplamak ve temizlemek; hem de bol bol veri.

grammar.note_tr: Sirali anlatimda ilk adimi verir: 'ilk adim ... yapmaktir'.

sentences.text_en: The better the data represents the problem, the better the results, garbage in, garbage out.
sentences.text_tr: Veri sorunu ne kadar iyi temsil ederse sonuclar da o kadar iyi olur; cop girerse cop cikar.

chunks.text_tr: cop girer cop cikar (kotu veri kotu sonuc)

grammar.note_tr: Iki seyin birlikte artmasi: 'the better..., the better...' = ne kadar ... o kadar ...

sentences.text_en: The data needs to have some kind of signal to be valuable to the algorithm for making predictions, and data scientists perform a job called feature engineering to transform raw data into features that better represent the underlying problem.
sentences.text_tr: Verinin, tahmin yaparken algoritmaya deger katmasi icin bir tur sinyal tasimasi gerekir; veri bilimcileri de ham veriyi, alttaki sorunu daha iyi temsil eden ozelliklere donusturmek icin oznitelik muhendisligi denen bir is yapar.

grammar.note_tr: Bir seye ad verir: 'a job called feature engineering' = ... denen bir is.

grammar.pattern: that better represent the underlying problem

sentences.text_en: The next step is to separate the data into a training set and testing set.
sentences.text_tr: Sonraki adim veriyi bir egitim kumesi ile bir test kumesine ayirmak.

sentences.text_en: The training data is fed into an algorithm to build a model, then the testing data is used to validate the accuracy or error of the model.
sentences.text_tr: Egitim verisi bir model kurmak icin algoritmaya beslenir; ardindan test verisi modelin dogrulugunu ya da hatasini olcmek icin kullanilir.

grammar.note_tr: Bir seyin amacini soyler: 'is used to validate' = dogrulamak icin kullanilir.

sentences.text_en: The next step is to choose an algorithm, which might be a simple statistical model like linear or logistic regression, or a decision tree that assigns different weights to features in the data, or you might get fancy with a convolutional neural network, which is an algorithm that also assigns weights to features, but also takes the input data and creates additional features automatically.
sentences.text_tr: Sonraki adim bir algoritma secmek; bu, dogrusal ya da lojistik regresyon gibi basit bir istatistiksel model olabilir, verideki ozniteliklere farkli agirliklar veren bir karar agaci olabilir, ya da isi buyutup bir evrisimli sinir agi kullanabilirsin; o da yine ozniteliklere agirlik veren, ama ayrica girdi verisini alip otomatik olarak ek oznitelikler ureten bir algoritmadir.

grammar.note_tr: Bir seyi tanimlar: 'a tree that assigns' = atayan bir agac.

grammar.pattern: which might be a simple statistical model like linear or logistic regression, or a decision tree that assigns different weights to features in the data
that assigns different weights to features in the data
which is an algorithm that also assigns weights to features
that also assigns weights to features

sentences.text_en: And that's extremely useful for datasets that contain things like images or natural language, where manual feature engineering is virtually impossible.
sentences.text_tr: Ve bu, gorseller ya da dogal dil gibi seyler iceren veri kumeleri icin son derece yararlidir; ki oralarda elle oznitelik muhendisligi neredeyse imkansizdir.

grammar.pattern: that contain things like images or natural language, where manual feature engineering is virtually impossible
where manual feature engineering is virtually impossible

sentences.text_en: Every one of these algorithms learns to get better by comparing its predictions to an error function.
sentences.text_tr: Bu algoritmalarin her biri, tahminlerini bir hata fonksiyonuyla karsilastirarak daha iyi olmayi ogrenir.

grammar.note_tr: Bir seyin nasil yapildigini soyler: 'by comparing' = karsilastirarak.

sentences.text_en: If it's a classification problem, like is this animal a cat or a dog, the error function might be accuracy.
sentences.text_tr: Eger bir siniflandirma problemiyse, mesela bu hayvan kedi mi kopek mi, hata fonksiyonu dogruluk olabilir.

grammar.note_tr: Gercek/olasi durum: 'if it's a problem, it might be...' = ise, olabilir.

sentences.text_en: If it's a regression problem, like how much will a loaf of bread costs next year, then it might be mean absolute error.
sentences.text_tr: Eger bir regresyon problemiyse, mesela gelecek yil bir somun ekmek ne kadar tutacak, o zaman ortalama mutlak hata olabilir.

grammar.note_tr: Kosul ve sonucu baglar: 'if..., then it might be' = ise, o zaman ... olabilir.

sentences.text_en: Python is the language of choice among data scientists, but R and Julia are also popular options, and there are many supporting frameworks out there to make the process approachable.
sentences.text_tr: Python, veri bilimcileri arasinda tercih edilen dildir; ama R ve Julia da populer secenekler ve sureci ulasilabilir kilmak icin ortalikta bircok destekleyici cerceve var.

grammar.note_tr: Bir seyin varligini soyler: 'there are many frameworks' = bircok cerceve var.

sentences.text_en: The end result of the machine learning process is a model, which is just a file that takes some input data in the same shape that it was trained on, then spits out a prediction that tries to minimize the error that it was optimized for.
sentences.text_tr: Makine ogrenmesi surecinin nihai sonucu bir modeldir; bu, egitildigi bicimde bir miktar girdi verisi alan, sonra optimize edildigi hatayi en aza indirmeye calisan bir tahmini disari veren bir dosyadir.

grammar.note_tr: Bir seyi tanimlar: 'a file that takes' = alan bir dosya.

grammar.pattern: which is just a file that takes some input data in the same shape that it was trained on
that takes some input data in the same shape that it was trained on
that tries to minimize the error that it was optimized for

sentences.text_en: It can then be embedded on an actual device or deployed to the cloud to build a real -world product.
sentences.text_tr: Ardindan gercek bir cihaza gomulebilir ya da gercek dunyada bir urun olusturmak icin buluta konuslandirilabilir.

sentences.text_en: This has been machine learning in 100 seconds.
sentences.text_tr: Iste 100 saniyede makine ogrenmesi buydu.

grammar.note_tr: Yeni biten bir seyi ozetler: 'this has been' = iste bu ... oldu/buydu.

sentences.text_en: Like and subscribe if you want to see more short videos like this, and leave a comment if you want to see more machine learning content on this channel.
sentences.text_tr: Boyle daha fazla kisa video gormek istiyorsan begen ve abone ol; bu kanalda daha fazla makine ogrenmesi icerigi istiyorsan da yorum birak.

grammar.note_tr: Kosullu rica/oneri: 'leave a comment if you want to...' = ... istiyorsan yorum birak.

grammar.pattern: if you want to see more short videos like this
if you want to see more machine learning content on this channel

sentences.text_en: Thanks for watching, and I will see you in the next one.
sentences.text_tr: Izlediginiz icin tesekkurler, bir sonrakinde gorusuruz.

chunks.text_en: see you in the next one
chunks.norm_key: see you in the next one

grammar.note_tr: Bir sey icin tesekkur: 'thanks for watching' = izledigin icin tesekkurler.
